verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is explicitly marketed as working entirely locally ('stays on your key, not their cloud', no software/drivers required), which implies no cloud usage-tracking to opt out of, but there is no explicit telemetry policy, settings, or opt-out control documented for the CLI/companion tooling. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/privacy policy statement, any opt-out toggle or setting, confirmation that the solo2 CLI/companion app sends no usage analytics.
